title: w6-reward-policy
description: L-REWARD-SLASH: Provider reward split + escrow-on-attest policy for inference payments. Holds payment until TEE/verifier ensemble attests; on 3-negative escalation slashes the dishonest provider via MyceliumStakeEscrow.
splitNotes: Shares MUST sum to 1.0. Integer-division remainder is allocated to treasury to make totals balance in base units. L-REWARD-95-5 (v3): TEE/verifier ensemble is operated by the protocol/treasury itself, so the 15% verifier-ensemble share is folded into the 5% treasury - net effect is 95% to providers, 5% to treasury.

escrow.escrowHoldNotes: Payment held in 'pending-attest' state for this many seconds awaiting ensemble attestation. Settled (split released) on OK attestation within window; refunded on FAIL or timeout. Composable with parent L-FANOUT (publishReceipt) and L-TEE-ENSEMBLE (attestation) flows.

slashing.triggerNotes: When ensemble reports three or more negative audit votes on the same jobId, payment is NOT released and the provider's staked amount is slashed via packages/economics/x1/src/MyceliumStakeEscrow.sol slash(provider, evidenceDigest). Slash is delegated to MyceliumStakeEscrow via dependency injection; this composition layer never broadcasts or signs.

policyInvariants: Same jobId holdPayment is idempotent (no double-hold)
settled / refunded / slashed are terminal states
